title: [DEV] "PH" gets added in Treatments history when manual bolus (not delivered by pump)
body:
AAPSClient 3.2.0-dev-l
Build: 471ed28a04-2023.09.14
Flavor: aapsclientrelease
Nightscout version: NS15 dev

Step by step
1) Bolus from AAPSClient or AAPS, toggle "do not bolus, record only". 
or
1) Bolus from AAPSClient Calculator (Possibly also Wear AAPSClient Calc and manual bolus / treat?)
2) Successful sync, but "PH" gets added to treatment history

Expected result would be only "NS".

[AndroidAPS_LOG_1694728318735.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/12613848/AndroidAPS_LOG_1694728318735.log.zip)

comments.body: @MilosKozak Could you apply the same fix to the Calculator in AAPSClient. If I do a bolus via the Calculator in AAPSClient "PH" gets added in treatment history as well. Maybe check Wear AAPSClient calculator, bolus, and treat also.
